title: Map Markers and Collectables by Raze
author: Raze
summary: Find tokens, beetles, and chests on your map and minimap. Optionally hide chests in unexplored areas, show height arrows, and customize which markers appear, their symbols, colors, and size.

required_mods.name: REFramework
required_mods.notes: Required. Install REFramework for Dragon's Dogma 2 before this mod.

main_file.name: Map Markers and Collectables by Raze
main_file.description: Version 1.3 adds an optional fog-of-war toggle for regular and special chests on both maps. Off by default. Includes all 1.2 features and fixes. Requires REFramework. Install the complete ZIP and restart the game.
